description: Header file for the AUTOSAR Communication Manager (ComM) module, defining constants, function prototypes, and includes relevant to communication management in an AUTOSAR-based system.

methods.name: ComM_Init
methods.description: Initializes the AUTOSAR Communication Manager with provided configuration.

methods.name: ComM_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current initialization status of the Communication Manager.

methods.name: ComM_GetInhibitionStatus
methods.description: Gets the inhibition status of a specific network channel.

methods.name: ComM_RequestComMode
methods.description: Requests a communication mode for a user.

methods.name: ComM_GetMaxComMode
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum communication mode available for a user.

methods.name: ComM_GetRequestedComMode
methods.description: Gets the currently requested communication mode for a user.

methods.name: ComM_GetCurrentComMode
methods.description: Gets the current communication mode for a user.

methods.name: ComM_PreventWakeUp
methods.description: Prevents or allows wake-up for a network channel.

methods.name: ComM_LimitChannelToNoComMode
methods.description: Limits a network channel to no communication mode.

methods.name: ComM_LimitECUToNoComMode
methods.description: Limits the ECU to no communication mode.

methods.name: ComM_SetECUGroupClassification
methods.description: Sets the ECU group classification status.
